summary: The GPT camp is out here making it look easy with the biggest pile of cash while the rest of the field either naps or self-destructs. The Claude camp dragged itself to the bottom with pocket change after its whole response got rejected for being a deprecated fossil that even the system couldn't bother parsing. DeepSeek and Gemini both looked like complete idiots repeatedly trying to sell with zero weight, getting their orders thrown out like they were submitting homework with no name on it.
